acceptance.behavior: The public login route initiates PKCE and the callback route completes the one-time exchange.
The callback presents a responsive, semantic live status while secure sign-in completes.
A successful exchange resolves the authenticated user and upserts the canonical profile before routing.
Existing profile role and onboarding authority takes precedence over callback role parameters.
The exact-revision browser specification emits all required PBOS evidence artifacts.
Browser coverage proves S256 binding, a single exchange, replay rejection, durable profile data, desktop, and mobile behavior.
The callback uses a labeled heading and polite live region and the browser specification checks serious and critical violations.
S256 PKCE uses one explicit exchange, removes the verifier after use, rejects replay, and never makes the verifier durable.
